crestboundProtector.adventure_scale_selection: One fixed family-pair scale, no perposefit: minimum of measured noalpha8-loss maxima across both variants, all6map parents and encounter parent in both facings. Preserves upgrade scale progression.

large.method: Fresh high-resolution painted head/neck/upperchest and physical crestcloth over own verified painted2D Ionian scene. Technical crop/fit/composition only; no new border or native portrait pixel reuse.

small.method: Fresh high-resolution painted head/neck/upperchest and physical crestcloth over own verified painted2D Ionian scene. Technical crop/fit/composition only; no new border or native portrait pixel reuse.

crestboundProtector.source_root_method: A fixed .58 torso/support anchor fraction for right-facing feline source silhouettes, .5 for explicit front/back turns; common physical floor registration, flight baseline8nativepx aboveground. Corrects generated airborne-foot ambiguity without pose synthesis or perpose scale fitting. Selected static holding registration unchanged.
crestboundProtector.source_scale_basis: Median ordinary/fidget painted actor height T5 or width T7, one scale for all five original action sheets. Single whole-cohort native widget calibration also applies holding master.
